issue.title: Show mux stat gives: could not retrieve key state value for port Ethernet4 inside table MUX_CABLE_TABLE on virtual switch

failure.body:
**Description**

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1.  `./testbed-cli.sh -t vtestbed.yaml -m veos_vtb -k ceos add-topo vms-kvm-dual-t0 password.txt`
2.  `./testbed-cli.sh -t vtestbed.yaml -m veos_vtb gen-mg vms-kvm-dual-t0 veos_vtb password.txt`
3. `./testbed-cli.sh -t vtestbed.yaml -m veos_vtb deploy-mg vms-kvm-dual-t0 veos_vtb password.txt`
4.  on vlab-05 or 06 run `show mux stat`

**Describe the results you received:**
```
admin@vlab-06:~$ show mux stat
could not retrieve key state value for port Ethernet4 inside table MUX_CABLE_TABLE
```
**Describe the results you expected:**

A list of mux cables and their current states

resolution.title: Disable tunnel qos remap on KVM testbed
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it
This PR is to disable tunnel qos remap on KVM testbed. It's because we have no qos map defined for tunnel on KVM.

Fixes: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/6162

#### How I did it
Update minigraph parser to check the `platform` name. If `kvm` is found, then tunnel qos remap is disabled.

#### How to verify it
Verified on a KVM dualtor testbed.
